facts_supersedes_self_check.name: facts_supersedes_self_check
facts_supersedes_self_check.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR supersedes_id <> id

facts_news_source_approved_check.name: facts_news_source_approved_check
facts_news_source_approved_check.value: status <> 'approved' OR type <> 'news_source' OR (source_url IS NOT NULL AND source_published_at IS NOT NULL)

facts_experience_approved_check.name: facts_experience_approved_check
facts_experience_approved_check.value: status <> 'approved' OR type <> 'experience_note' OR (consent_confirmed AND anonymized)

facts_product_approved_check.name: facts_product_approved_check
facts_product_approved_check.value: status <> 'approved' OR type <> 'product_fact' OR product_id IS NOT NULL

publications_published_url_check.name: publications_published_url_check
publications_published_url_check.value: status <> 'published' OR external_url IS NOT NULL

reviews_comment_check.name: reviews_comment_check
reviews_comment_check.value: decision = 'approved' OR comment IS NOT NULL

reviews_rating_check.name: reviews_rating_check
reviews_rating_check.value: rating is null or (rating >= 1 and rating <= 5)

reviews_rubric_check.name: reviews_rubric_check
reviews_rubric_check.value:
(
        (rubric_accuracy is null or (rubric_accuracy >= 1 and rubric_accuracy <= 5)) and
        (rubric_style is null or (rubric_style >= 1 and rubric_style <= 5)) and
        (rubric_readability is null or (rubric_readability >= 1 and rubric_readability <= 5)) and
        (rubric_hooks is null or (rubric_hooks >= 1 and rubric_hooks <= 5)) and
        (rubric_cliches is null or (rubric_cliches >= 1 and rubric_cliches <= 5))
      )
